title: What Graphene-Based Microprocessors Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Graphene-based microprocessors build transistors from single-atom carbon sheets: graphene's electron mobility dwarfs silicon's, promising terahertz switching and extreme efficiency — if the bandgap problem (graphene has none) can be engineered around. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Graphene-Based Microprocessors: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Graphene-Based Microprocessors in one line: Graphene-based microprocessors build transistors from single-atom carbon sheets: graphene's electron mobility dwarfs silicon's, promising terahertz switching and extreme efficiency — if the bandgap problem (graphene has none) can be engineered around.
Why it matters: Graphene moves electrons 100x faster than silicon; taming it means post-silicon speed..
Where it is used: RF electronics, ultra-fast logic, flexible processors, THz communications..
